narrative.overview: Original generated product screenshots replace the coded showcase specimens. Each project has independent typography, scoped colour roles and a nested system page. Shared portfolio wayfinding stays consistent.
keyCharacteristics: Afterhours: After the lights go down

rules.name: Scoped identity
rules.body: Use each project's own tokens and font family inside its data-world boundary.

rules.name: Image-led product artwork
rules.body: Render the generated UI image intact; keep working exercises and provenance outside the artwork.

rules.name: Explicit source limits
rules.body: References are inspiration. Generated screenshots and synthetic evidence are illustrative, not production results.

dos: Retain accessible real controls in separate exercises.
donts: Do not reconstruct or overlay the app screenshots in HTML.
Do not add conceptual stamps to the artwork.
Do not claim unperformed browser verification.
